sources.title: DPO Baseline IT Security Policy [S17] v8.2

limitations: Curated partial clause coverage only. The baseline is an assessment target, never a national security grade or a certification decision.
Classified-information conditions must be confirmed. G3 guidance and department-specific policies are not fully represented.
